baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of taking a covenant, dispatching twelve naqibs, and then stating the conditions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Taking places the covenant under custody, confirmed binding secures it, dispatch makes it operative, and the naqib as guarantor and investigator distributes responsibility through the represented body.

activation_trace.role: Taking as acquisition or custody makes the covenant something actively seized and held, not merely announced.
Firm fastening supplies the covenant's structural stability.
A confirmed compact identifies the binding as an emphatic mutual obligation.
Dispatch and directed sending turn the compact into an administered mission.
Joining one to another supplies the compositional first part of the bounded representative number.
The number ten completes the explicit count of the dispatched representative array.
The naqib as a people's guarantor, witness, and responsible chief supplies distributed accountability.
Investigation of interiors and reports adds an oversight function to representation.

changed_reading.before: God made a covenant and appointed twelve leaders.
changed_reading.after: The ayah constructs an administered covenant: a secured obligation is placed in the custody of a distributed corps of guarantor-investigators who make collective fidelity observable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional chain from establishing prayer and giving zakat through the good loan to expiation, entry, and flowing rivers.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maintained worship, growth-bearing giving, support of messengers, and a loan cut from present possession form an outgoing circuit; its promised return is protective covering, admission to a sheltered fertile space, and continuing provision.

activation_trace.role: Care, preservation, and responsible maintenance make establishing prayer an ongoing upheld practice.
Growth and increase make zakat a productive release rather than a dead subtraction.
Aid joined to honoring makes support of the messengers both material and status-bearing.
A portion of wealth or action is cut out and advanced so that its recompense returns, defining the reciprocal hinge.
Covering and effacing sin supplies the first form of promised return.
A garden screened by dense growth supplies a protected and fertile destination.
Continuing provision or gift makes the river image a durable return rather than a momentary prize.
A channel cut through earth by abundant running water gives the return a regenerative material form.

changed_reading.before: The conditions are duties rewarded by forgiveness and paradise.
changed_reading.after: The conditions form a covenantal circulation: disciplined maintenance and released value pass outward, then return as covered liability, protected entry, and provision that keeps flowing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired forms from the K-F-R root followed by entry into gardens on one side and loss of the level center of the path on the other.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root stages contrary coverings: God protectively covers bad acts, while post-covenant rejection covers truth or blessing. Protective covering opens entry into shelter; occlusive covering destroys orientation and loses the equitable middle of a traversable way.

activation_trace.role: Effacing an offense is protective covering and marks the restorative pole of the root.
Blocking the truth supplies the root's contrary, disorienting pole.
Covering a received benefit sharpens why rejection after the stated promise is a betrayal of recognized favor.
Passage from outside to inside makes reward an actual threshold crossing.
Sheltering concealment distinguishes the garden's protection from rejection's occlusion.
Departure from guidance converts rejection into failed navigation.
The middle, equitable, level position specifies what part of the route is lost.
A road extended for passage makes covenant fidelity a navigable course.

changed_reading.before: God forgives believers, while a later unbeliever leaves the right path.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts two kinds of covering with opposite spatial effects: restorative covering admits into protected life, whereas covering truth or favor erases the route's level and equitable center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening command to complete bound obligations and the later covenant formula of hearing and obeying make the focus covenant a circuit from binding speech through receptive understanding to enacted compliance.

activation_trace.role: The focus compact is the secured obligation whose enactment the context clarifies.
Completion without deficiency defines fulfillment as bringing an obligation to its full measure.
Binding and ratifying an obligation supplies the legal knot that fulfillment must preserve.
The repeated confirmed covenant ties the quoted response directly to the focus's compact.
Hearing as comprehension and compliance makes reception already action-oriented.
Willing submission closes the circuit by converting heard terms into conduct.

structural_cues: 5:1 opens the pericope by commanding fulfillment of bound obligations.
5:7 repeats covenant vocabulary and places the response 'we heard and obeyed' before the focus's detailed conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, binding, repeated covenant, hearing, and obedience; I infer a speech-to-practice circuit. A live alternative is that 5:1 and 5:7 are parallel legal reminders without specifying an internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus lists the terms attached to a past covenant.
changed_reading.after: The focus reconstructs what 'we heard and obeyed' must continuously mean: each condition is a conversion point where received covenant speech becomes maintained practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The naqib's guarantee and the command to support are constrained by the surrounding demand that hatred not produce transgression or injustice. Representation therefore guards an impartial covenantal center rather than merely consolidating group loyalty.

activation_trace.role: A guarantor and witness for the people supplies the representative office that context subjects to justice.
An equitable middle position makes the path's center juridical as well as spatial.
Active hatred supplies the pressure under which covenantal judgment can bend.
Mutual assistance is explicitly sorted into legitimate and illegitimate cooperation, constraining support by its object.
Equity and fair apportionment define the standard borne by witnesses.
Justice in judgment and conduct supplies the corrective action demanded despite hostility.

structural_cues: 5:2 forbids hostile grievance from causing transgression and distinguishes cooperation in good from cooperation in wrongdoing.
5:8 joins standing, witness, equity, repeated justice, and nearness to vigilance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies representative guarantee, conditional assistance, hostile pressure, witness, and justice; I infer that naqib oversight protects the covenant from partisan distortion. The alternative is that the justice commands regulate individuals without defining the naqibs' office.

changed_reading.before: The twelve naqibs are leaders who help administer the group's covenant.
changed_reading.after: The twelve are accountable guarantor-witnesses whose office is to keep collective support on the equitable center even when hatred makes partiality attractive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby overlap of obedience, reckoning, and financial debt in D-Y-N, followed by completion, promise, and wage, gives the good-loan clause a covenantal ledger: conduct is advanced under a completed order and receives the explicitly promised return.

activation_trace.role: An advance made for returned recompense is the focus's explicit accounting metaphor.
Obedience and submission place the completed din on the conduct side of the ledger.
Financial debt supplies a live lexical bridge from din to the focus's loan and repayment image.
Completion marks the order as brought to wholeness rather than left provisional.
Bringing favor to its full measure supplies the completed benefaction against which response is due.
A promise that opens hope makes the return verbally guaranteed.
Compensation for work names the recompense side of the exchange.

structural_cues: 5:3 repeats din around the declarations of completing the din and completing favor.
5:9 pairs promised forgiveness with a great wage, closely matching the focus's expiation and returned good loan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the loan, the D-Y-N branch range, completion, promise, and wage; I infer a ledger-like coherence without implying divine need. The live alternative is ordinary juxtaposition of separate legal, religious, and reward vocabularies.

changed_reading.before: The good loan is an isolated metaphor for generous giving.
changed_reading.after: The good loan is the accounting hinge of a larger covenantal economy in which completed favor calls for obedient expenditure and the promisor names forgiveness and wage as return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, hostile hands are extended and then restrained by God. The focus answers with a different outward movement: supporting messengers and advancing a good loan. Divine withness becomes protective interception, while human fidelity becomes beneficial release rather than harmful reach.

activation_trace.role: Aid joined with honor supplies the constructive use of human power.
Value deliberately advanced for return supplies the beneficial outward transfer.
Extending and releasing the hand supplies the attempted outward motion of harm.
The hand as instrument of transfer makes hostile reach and covenantal giving bodily counterparts.
Restraint and prevention supply the protective action associated with divine accompaniment.
Reliance connects remembered protection to the focus's assurance of divine withness.

structural_cues: 5:11 immediately precedes the focus and repeats God, believers, vigilance, and reliance.
The preceding ayah opposes an attempted extension of hands to God's restraining of those same hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile extension, divine restraint, reliance, support, and loan; I infer a contrast between harmful and beneficial outward uses of agency. The alternative is that the hand scene only recalls a discrete rescue.

changed_reading.before: God's 'I am with you' is general reassurance attached to obedience.
changed_reading.after: Divine withness has an embodied reciprocal pattern: God blocks predatory reach, while covenant partners redirect their own reach into honoring support and value-bearing release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence renders breach as progressive structural failure: a bound compact is unfastened, the responsive interior hardens, words are bent away from direction and displaced from their settings, and an assigned share is abandoned.

activation_trace.role: A fastening or bond supplies the structure later undone.
The equitable center of the path supplies the orientation lost through displacement.
Undoing what was firmly joined directly reverses the focus's secured covenant.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies an internal state unable to receive or flex with the compact.
Inclination away from a direction converts textual alteration into route deviation.
Putting something in its fixed place makes removal from proper settings a structural displacement.
Leaving and neglecting a portion completes breach as failed custody rather than mere lapse of recall.

structural_cues: 5:13 begins with covenant breach and then orders hardening, alteration, displacement, and forgetting in one sentence.
The sequence follows immediately after the focus's warning about post-covenant rejection and route loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered failures; I infer a causal disassembly from bond to interior to wording to custody. A live alternative treats them as several consequences and offenses without a single failure chain.

changed_reading.before: Post-covenant disbelief is a generic wrong turn punished by straying.
changed_reading.after: The wrong turn has mechanics: the bond is unfastened, receptivity hardens, terms are displaced, and entrusted content is dropped until the covenant no longer holds a common route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated loss of an allotted share in 5:13-14 activates the naqibs as a distributed memory and inspection system. When that custody fails, the omitted share leaves relational space to be occupied by incited, adhesive hostility.

activation_trace.role: Inquiry into hidden matters and reports supports a monitoring and memory-recovery function.
The guarantor responsible for a people supplies the distributed custodian.
Neglecting and leaving something supplies the first failed custody event.
An allotted share specifies that what is lost is a distributed portion, not an undefined whole.
The repeated neglect in the parallel covenant case makes omission a cross-community failure pattern.
The repeated allotted share reinforces the distributed character of what should have been retained.
Adhesive sticking supplies the strange but concrete image of hostility becoming relational glue.
Incitement supplies the explicit force that activates and sustains that hostile attachment.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the relational field in which hostility settles.
Enmity supplies the durable adversarial relation produced after failed retention.
Aversion of the self supplies the affective charge of the broken relational field.

structural_cues: 5:13 and 5:14 repeat the same construction of forgetting an allotted share from what was recalled to them.
The second parallel case immediately follows omission with incited enmity and hatred between the parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies representative guarantors, investigative capacity, repeated omitted shares, and subsequent hostility; I assign the naqibs a distributed-memory function and infer that omission opens a relational vacancy. A live alternative is that the naqibs are political chiefs and the repeated forgetting is unrelated to their function.

changed_reading.before: The twelve naqibs provide political representation for the covenant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the twelve form a distributed custody and recall network: each safeguards an allotted portion, and failure of that network allows hostility to become what binds the fragmented parties.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disclosure and light make the route visible; guidance then moves followers out of obscurity through multiple peace-making ways toward a straight road. The focus's loss of the path-center is therefore exclusion from a revealed, peace-producing transition rather than abstract error.

activation_trace.role: The level and equitable middle identifies the orientation whose loss the context makes visible.
A traversable extended road anchors the contextual guidance sequence back in the focus.
Emergence and disclosure make hidden route information perceptible.
Illumination supplies the medium by which the way can be discerned.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies active orientation.
Plural traversable roads make peace a practiced route network.
Reconciliation opposed to war defines what the guided paths produce socially.
Bringing something out from concealment makes guidance a transition rather than static information.
The destination in illumination opposes the occlusive covering activated by rejection.
The straight road supplies the convergent orientation of the plural peace-making paths.

structural_cues: 5:15 orders messenger, disclosure, light, and clear book.
5:16 orders guidance, paths of peace, emergence from darkness, light, renewed guidance, and a straight road.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the disclosure-to-guidance sequence; I infer that the plural peace paths converge functionally on the straight route and illuminate the focus's path-center. The alternative is a set of parallel salvation images without a single route mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Whoever rejects the covenant has simply left the correct path.
changed_reading.after: Rejection forfeits a disclosed route-making process: light reveals, guidance moves, peace reconciles, and the traveler is brought onto the straight and equitable center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later claim to be God's children and beloved is answered by punishment for sins and common human creatureliness. This prevents 'Children of Israel' and 'I am with you' in the focus from becoming hereditary immunity: lineage identifies the accountable body, while accompaniment remains conditional.

activation_trace.role: Filiation and descent identify the named covenant community.
The asserted filial relation activates the risk of construing lineage as privilege.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the asserted special-favor claim.
Punitive pain directly tests and rejects automatic immunity.
Sin and culpability make accountability attach to conduct rather than ancestry.
Ordinary visible humanity levels the asserted exceptional genealogy.

structural_cues: 5:18 places the claim of divine filiation and belovedness against the question of punishment for sins.
The reply reduces the claimants to humans among those created, while retaining forgiveness and punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared filiation root, the privilege claim, and its accountability rebuttal; I infer that it governs how the focus's lineage title and conditional withness are read. The alternative confines the rebuttal to the later speakers' specific boast.

changed_reading.before: The covenant is a special promise to a genealogically named people.
changed_reading.after: The genealogy locates responsibility but grants no immunity: divine withness is renewed through the listed acts and can be lost after recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later land sequence tests the focus's promised entry and divine withness. Entry requires forward crossing through a gate under trust; turning back, outsourcing the struggle to 'you and your Lord,' and sitting still invert co-presence and end in wandering.

activation_trace.role: Promised passage from outside to inside anchors the later sequence of commanded and refused entry.
Loss of directed travel anchors the later wandering consequence.
The imperative to cross inward makes entry an enacted demand, not passive transport.
Turning back from committed obedience supplies the covenantal reversal.
Giving the back and withdrawing supplies the bodily geometry of reversal.
Repeated entry links the command, the threshold crossing, and the expected changed state.
The gate as an ingress point gives the commanded trust a concrete threshold.
Overcoming force is presented as the state reached after, not before, crossing.
Going forward is assigned away to Moses and his Lord, severing the people from co-action.
Lordship is rhetorically placed beside Moses while the speakers detach themselves from the mission.
Mutual combat names the difficult action the speakers outsource.
Sitting back from action supplies the exact behavioral opposite of covenantal co-presence.

structural_cues: 5:21 joins entry with a prohibition on turning back and the consequence of becoming losers.
5:23 makes the gate crossing precede victory and pairs the action with reliance on God.
5:24 separates 'you and your Lord' from 'we are sitting here,' reversing the focus's 'I am with you.'
5:26 uses the branchless T-Y-H occurrence for wandering in the land after refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies promised entry, commanded entry, gate, reversal, reliance, rhetorical separation, sitting, and wandering; I read the later speech as an anti-formula of the focus's withness. The live alternative is a local military refusal that does not define the earlier promise.

changed_reading.before: God's presence guarantees eventual admission to gardens if the listed duties are met.
changed_reading.after: Withness and entry are co-active: the covenant partner must cross the offered threshold under trust. Turning the mission into 'you two go' while remaining seated breaks that co-presence and converts entry into wandering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the physical N-Q-B images of piercing and a pass through rough ground into a social title. It remains anchored in naqib, the focus's entry promise, and the later gate-entry sequence; downstream prose should present it as a lexical-material activation, not as a replacement definition of naqib.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word naqib between dispatch and the long conditional route ending in entry or path-loss.

activation_trace.role: Piercing an opening through to what lies beyond supplies a threshold-making image for the office.
A pass that penetrates mountain or rough ground makes the naqib a possible route-finder through obstruction.
The ordinary guarantor-chief branch keeps the physical activation attached to a valid social function.
The later gate supplies the concrete ingress point toward which a pass-making representative would lead.
Repeated crossing into an interior supplies the collective movement enabled by the opened route.
Overcoming after entry makes passage through the obstruction, not prior domination, the decisive move.

changed_reading.before: A naqib is a representative leader standing over one segment of the people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a naqib is a pass-making guarantor: one who investigates the obstruction, opens a viable route through it, and becomes answerable for the people's crossing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it turns the physical cutting branch of Q-R-D into a material topology linking loan, growth, channel, and flow. It remains anchored in the doubled loan root and the focus's own garden-river outcome; downstream prose should qualify it as an image of relinquishment and circulation, not claim that every river detail encodes finance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled Q-R-D expression followed by covered liabilities, garden entry, and rivers running beneath.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and separating a portion makes the loan a real relinquishment from present possession.
Advancing the separated portion for returned recompense keeps the cutting image within the attested loan mechanism.
Increase and growth supply the productive transformation of what was released.
A continuing gift or provision renders the return durative and circulating.
Opening and widening until something flows converts separated value into an image of newly made channels.

changed_reading.before: The good loan is repaid by a separate reward pictured as gardens and rivers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the loan's cut portion is not lost but rerouted: relinquishment opens a channel in which value grows and returns as provision that continues to flow.

strongest_changes: The focus covenant became an administered system of guarantor-witnesses, not only a promise made to a group.
The immediate hand scene made divine withness protective and human fidelity a redirection of agency from harmful reach to supportive release.
The post-focus breach sequence supplied a concrete disassembly: unfastening, hardening, displacement, neglect, and eventual route loss.
The later gate, refusal, sitting, and wandering sequence made promised entry and divine withness depend on co-active crossing under trust.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates a material grammar of fastening, custody, covering, cutting, entry, shelter, flow, and route. The pericope then stress-tests that grammar through contracts, hearing and obedience, hostile hands, impartial witness, covenant breach, disclosure, lineage claims, and a refused gate.
remaining_uncertainties: The pass-making naqib is well anchored lexically but remains form-distant from the ordinary social title.
The din-debt-loan ledger may be a productive lexical resonance rather than one intended accounting system.
The parallel forgotten shares support a distributed-memory reading of the naqibs, but the packet does not explicitly assign them that function.
